Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Unfortunately there were problems with the courses that I wanted to take. And I'm not sure the process of then figuring something else was that easy or whether the people that could help were that forthcoming.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I was only in contact with the person handling incoming students.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not that succesful considering that there were rules that I didn't know about before and the courses were suddenly cancelled.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Try to have a lot of alternatives for courses

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Some courses were very manageable and others were not that manageable.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I prefer the teaching style at UCPH a lot more than at UVA. At UCHP the goal is that you get to learn new theory and the people that teach care that every student interesting in learning gets to understand the relevant theory. At UVA I felt that I was left on my own to figure everything out.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Portfolio Theory, Asymptotic Statistics, Stochastic Simulation, Numerical Algorithms, High-Dimensional Probability, Computational Finance

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Numerical Algorithms was an interesting course and it was not too hard to understand, but not too easy either.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was relatively easy. Also considering that danish culture is kind of similar

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: I didn't end up talking to that many local students.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Dutch people are very direct. Which is something to get used to.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I liked their language and ended up finding people that where quite easy to talk to.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Go out and meet people. Try eating one traditional danish food. Go to a museum.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Danish people can be kind of closed of. It has nothing to do with you, but that's just how the culture is.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Going out and meeting new people and getting new acquaintances

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Going out and meeting new people and getting new acquaintances
